DNA Absorption

Iris (Gamera) absorbing Gamera's DNA.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb DNA.

The ability to absorb DNA and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of DNA Manipulation. Variation of Organic Absorption.

Contents

  • 1 Also Called

  • 3 Applications
  • 4 Associations
  • 5 Limitations
  • 6 Known Users

Also Called[]

  • DNA Assimilation

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb DNA/genetic information, while removing it from the source, into their body and use it in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, using it as power source etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Common advantage includes gaining targets skills, appearance, and powers if they have innate ones.

Applications[]

  • Biological Assimilation
  • Biomorphing
  • Assimilation Shield Construction
  • Haemopotent Replication
  • Organic Empowerment
  • Organic Regeneration
  • Peak Human Condition
    • Enhanced Condition
      • Supernatural Condition
        • Absolute Condition
  • Power Absorption

Associations[]

  • Animal Morphing
  • DNA Manipulation
  • DNA Replication
  • Organic Absorption
  • Plant Mimicry
  • Power Replication

Limitations[]

  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • May gain the physical weaknesses of their targets e.g., if the user absorbed the DNA of a Fire Mimic then they would have an aversion to water and ice.
  • May be affected by target's personality.
  • Users of Genelessness, Absorption Immunity, and/or Absorption Negation are immune.
